metadata.description: Collection of Claude Code plugins by Yorrick Jansen

plugins.name: self-improve-skill
plugins.description: Automatically reflects on skills used in sessions and proposes improvements

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Automated development loop: brainstorm, plan, implement, PR, then iterative review (simplify + code review + security review) until clean

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Multi-provider interactive PR code review. Runs Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI in parallel, merges findings, then lets you vet each issue before posting to GitHub.

plugins.name: agent-session-monitor
plugins.description: Monitor and steer Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal coding agents through tmux panes.
